function.description: Execute a REAL on-chain token swap on Uniswap. SPENDS FUNDS: it signs and broadcasts a transaction from your wallet. REQUIRES a fresh matching SwapQuoteUniswap FIRST on the SAME venue; a KyberSwap quote cannot authorize it. EVM ONLY, and only on the EVM chains with a verified Vex Uniswap deployment. For an EVM token, call TokenFind with exactly one target chain and continue only when mutationReady is true. Ambiguous, provider-capped, or metadata-unreadable results are not executable identities. If the swap pair is already known, prefer its exact base or quote token address and use TokenFind to validate that address on the target chain. TokenFind reads symbol and decimals from the contract, never provider list metadata. `amountIn` is the HUMAN decimal of tokenIn. Restricted approval shows chain, token addresses, human `amountIn`, and the quote/floor with its quote-time contract-read output symbol. It omits decimals and atomic input and does not independently re-read metadata. The card also carries a QUOTE-TIME spendability line - the source-token requirement and the total native debit including every fee leg and the reserve - labelled as a quote-time observation and re-read before signing; it is disclosure, not the check, and it is not a live balance. Execution re-reads both token contracts and refuses unreadable metadata before signing; the card is not proof. Full permission shows no card. BALANCE IS RE-READ HERE AND THAT READ IS THE AUTHORITY, not the quote's: immediately before EACH transaction is signed the input-token and native balances are read again at the pending block and must cover that transaction, every transaction still authorized after it (including the fee transfer) and a measured follow-up reserve. A wallet that no longer covers them is refused with NOTHING signed and nothing broadcast, stating required, held and missing, and the refusal distinguishes a wallet that is SHORT from a balance that could not be READ. A quote that was executable minutes ago is not a guarantee here. Returns the transaction hash and the resulting wallet deltas; failed and pending attempts are recorded and shown with chain + tx hash + explorer link, same as confirmed ones. KyberSwap is the primary swap route - reach for this one when KyberSwap cannot serve the pair or its quote failed for a routing reason.
function.name: SwapExecuteUniswap

amountIn.description: Amount of tokenIn to swap, in HUMAN decimal units (e.g. "1.5"). Not wei.

chain.description: EVM chain to swap on (ethereum, base, arbitrum, robinhood, …) — Uniswap ONLY, no venue routing. Solana is NOT supported by this tool.

slippageBps.description: Slippage tolerance in basis points (1 bps = 0.01%); default 100 = 1%, which fits deep, liquid pairs. It is the ONLY price protection on the trade. Pass the SAME value to the quote and the execute, or omit it on both — a mismatch blocks the execute. On a thin or volatile pair (new listings, memecoins, small pools) 100 bps often fails. When it fails, the message says so and names this parameter: re-quote with a higher slippageBps and pass the same value to the execute. Do not read a slippage failure as "this pair is untradeable" and do not switch venue for it — another venue at 100 bps fails the same way. Vex caps it at 1000 (10%) and REJECTS anything above rather than clamping; every increase widens the worst-case price you accept, so raise it in steps.
